title: Antigravity CLI
description: Google's Antigravity CLI (agy) as a coding agent in Tomrade: a ticket goes to agy in a terminal, its own sessions reach Tomrade once connected, and its sign-in answers Tomrade's background calls.

why.fs: Reads which address the `tomrade` server has in ~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json; after a background call it deletes that call's conversation from ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli, and runs the call from an empty temporary folder.
why.exec: Runs your own `agy` command: in a terminal for a ticket, `agy mcp add` and `agy mcp remove` to connect it, and agy in print mode for background calls.
